plain: Happening by chance rather than by plan.

webster.text: Accidental; casual; happening by chance; coming or occurring unexpectedly, or without any known cause.

example.quote: For, from fortuitous circumstances, those states deviated from their natural character — Jersey in not giving up the right of the Mississippi, and Maryland in giving it up.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 13, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
